_campaign.name: MDM2 V2 allosteric activator (Lid+beta-loop site, distinct from V1 orthosteric Nutlin cleft)
_campaign.relation_to_v1: V1 (mdm2_activator) targeted orthosteric Nutlin cleft at [-23.835, 7.530, -14.053] - likely INHIBITORS. V2 targets allosteric Lid+beta-loop site on opposite face - potential ACTIVATORS. Both campaigns archived; wet-lab mechanism triage required.

_pocket.pdb_title_verified: Crystal structure of an MDM2/Nutlin-3a complex
_pocket.pocket_strategy: Lid-adjacent (aa 17-30) + beta2-beta3 loop (aa 60-70) convergent allosteric site on back-face of N-terminal domain. Deliberately excludes F19/W23/L26 Nutlin-hotspot residues.

_rationale.sma_link: Meta-analysis: TP53 pooled +0.260, p=0.030 UP in SMA MN (3 datasets). Apoptosis axis PERP/PUMA/NOXA elevated. Want MDM2 activator to reduce p53 signaling.
_rationale.why_allosteric: Orthosteric Nutlin-cleft binders compete with p53 -> stabilize p53 -> OPPOSITE of SMA need. Allosteric Lid stabilizers hypothesized to enhance MDM2 conformational productivity without blocking p53 access.
_rationale.first_in_class: No clinical-stage MDM2 activator (allosteric or orthosteric). V1 and V2 are exploratory chemotype generation.
_rationale.v1_vs_v2_validation: V1 likely INHIBITORS (wrong direction). V2 potential ACTIVATORS (right direction). Only wet-lab p53 half-life + K48-Ub-p53 can distinguish. Open question, documented as such.

_caveats: 4HG7 covers only aa 17-125 - C-terminal acidic/RING allosteric sites absent.
Lid stabilization -> activator is plausible but unproven in drug-discovery literature.
Distance > 15A is geometric only; allostery requires functional coupling.
Allosteric pocket binder could still act as non-competitive inhibitor (reduce MDM2 dynamics).
EXPLORATORY only - no external comms until wet-lab mechanism confirmation.
